apps.name: Husk
apps.subtitle: Android apps and PS4 games on your iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: Husk runs Android apps and games, and PlayStation 4 games, on iPhone. Its Translation Layer runs games made with Unity, Unreal, Godot, Flutter, cocos2d-x, SDL and more natively, a full Android system is there for everything else, and its PS4 layer plays fake packages and game folders (iOS 17.4+). Husk needs JIT: StikDebug, its built-in StikJIT, TrollStore or a jailbreak — or Play without JIT after you import a certificate.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's new?

3.4 is a compatibility release. About 97% of the 472 F-Droid apps we test now run, up from 85%. On the 169 Play Store apps we test, about 90% run, not counting apps with anti-tamper or fraud protection, which Husk doesn't try to bypass. All of these numbers are from testing on a Mac.

### More Android apps
- Microsoft Word opens (Excel and PowerPoint share its libraries)
- Slack, Gmail, Teams, Deezer, Flipboard and Picsart get past the crashes that stopped them
- More engines and frameworks start: React Native's new architecture, Qt 6 / QML, and apps using JavaScriptCore
- libGDX and other OpenGL apps draw again (3.3 broke these)
- Apps that keep secrets in Android's secure key store work better
- Apps with big bundled databases open
- UPnP and network discovery apps can start
- Apps that declare their launch screen in a split APK can start

### Looks better
- Rounded buttons are proper pills instead of ellipses
- Toolbars, window backgrounds and more color formats behave like they do on a phone

### Less "out of memory"
- Fewer `OutOfMemoryError: pthread_create` crashes on installs without extended address space
- Unity games use less address space on sideloaded installs, and keep their frame rate up
- New in Settings -> Performance: see whether Increased Memory Limit and Extended Address Space are on for your install

### Also
- Japanese, thanks to @Yuki-1018
- Fixed Husk crashing when importing a `.p12`, or at launch with one saved on iOS 27 (#220)
- The Remove and Uninstall dialogs open next to their buttons on iPad (#218)
- Winlator's Settings page no longer crashes
- Husk builds with Xcode 27 and the iOS 27 SDK

## Known Issues
- Without JIT, Minecraft, some Flutter apps and some LÖVE games can fail. Use StikJIT for those for now
- Browsers (Firefox, Brave, Opera) don't run yet because they need separate helper processes
- Husk's Java runtime still has no garbage collector, so big apps can run out of memory in long sessions (#191)
- Touch doesn't work yet in Godot 3 games (#200)
- Apps with anti-tamper still won't run, and neither will apps that need Google Play services or a Google account
- Winlator containers don't run
- Full Android is still slow. Use the translation layer for games

## Thanks
Thanks to @BartolomeoRusso9, @Dey410 and @Yuki-1018 for their pull requests, and to everyone who sent logs. Crash reports are what made this release possible ❤️

## Links
- Website: https://itslevii.dev

## Play without JIT
More games convert and sign their libraries on the device. One library that cannot convert no longer stops the rest. Certificates from SideStore, AltStore, or a `.p12` import more reliably, and converted libraries are signed again after this update.

## More Android apps
Java apps pick up missing platform classes from AOSP when `framework.jar` is bundled. Jobs and boot receivers actually start, and Wi-Fi, location, and settings answer as a running phone would.

## Importing files
The in-app file picker for Android apps can be used more than once in a session.

## 32-bit ARM apps
APKs that only ship `armeabi-v7a` libraries are translated to arm64. This path is still incomplete (Minecraft PE is the current test case).

## Fixes
Certificate import, leftover store passwords on a `.p12`, the file picker after the first pick, game pages on iOS 15, and StikDebug when Husk is inside a container app.
Fixed certificate importing bug for 3.2 JIT-less

## What's new?

Play without JIT: Most translation-layer games run with no debugger and no StikJIT. Turn it on in Settings -> Play without JIT.

- Import the certificate SideStore or AltStore installed Husk with, or a `.p12`
- The first time you open a game, Husk converts its libraries. After that it starts like normal
- StikJIT is still there if you want it

### Games

- Unity 6 games get further (Flying Gorilla, Deep Rock Galactic Survivor, and others)
- Games that ask for OpenGL ES 3.1 don't fall over on launch
- Unity games that load Firebase / extra plugins through `UnityPlayer.loadLibrary` start
- Minecraft's huge libraries load
- Python-for-Android games convert their bundled libraries too
- Games that try to JIT their own code (LuaJIT, PCRE2) fall back the way they do on a phone, instead of needing Husk's JIT

### Also

- Starting full Android makes you wait five seconds on the warning. It's still the emulator. Don't use it for games
- Compatibility reports wait if the site is down, then send
- Certificate passwords (including empty ones) actually work
- Lots of fixes under Play without JIT so Unity and C++ games don't die on the first exception

## Known Issues

- Some games still need JIT (ones that generate code at runtime, including a few with their own anti-tamper)
- Hollow Knight and Cuphead still have no sound
- Some games (Disco Elysium, Muse Dash) don't take touch input
- 32-bit only apps don't run
- The first convert of a big game can take a while and some disk
- Full Android is still slow and crashy. Use Play without JIT / the translation layer for games

## Final notes

Thank you all for your repeated support over the past few weeks with Husk ❤️ . I hope you like this new JIT-less release <3

## Links:

- Website: https://itslevii.dev
- Discord: https://itslevii.dev/discord
- X Profile: https://x.com/leviidev01
- Discord User: @Leviidev

Full Changelog: https://github.com/Leviidev/Husk/compare/3.1...main

## What's new?
- New UI, all over
    - New Home, Library, Store and game pages
    - Every screen, Settings included, uses the same navy look
- Husk accounts
    - Sign in from the top of Settings
    - Your profile, playtime and library sync with itslevii.dev
- New Import screen: APK, split APKs (.xapk, .apkm, .apks), OBBs and PS4 game folders. On iPad you can drag files onto it.
- Small icon size for the library
- Chinese (Simplified) for all of Husk. The language you pick in setup is used by Husk and your apps.
### Store
- New app page
    - Proper descriptions (bold, lists, links)
    - Short counts, like 1B+ downloads and 37M reviews
    - Tap screenshots to view them full screen, with zoom
    - Trailers, What's New, Highlights, tags and developer links
- Store downloads can be stopped, and show in Downloads
### Android
- Keyboard button for apps and games. Typing works even when there's no text box.
- In-app file picker: when an app asks for a file, the iOS file picker opens
- Fullscreen games are centered and use the whole screen (Plants vs. Zombies and more)
- Cocos Creator games start
- Godot 4.7 games can save
- Flutter apps find their fonts
- .NET apps run much further
- Apps protected with Dex2C work
- Android system pop-ups (Bluetooth, NFC…) don't break apps anymore
- XAPKs with OBB files inside install correctly
- Battery, 24-hour clock, time zone and language follow your phone
### Also
- TrollStore and Dopamine on iOS 15–16 get JIT even when iOS refuses the usual way
- The TrollStore build opens on devices it didn't before
- Built-in StikJIT finds the pairing port by itself
- Crash reports tell you when iOS closed Husk for using too much memory
- Compatibility list and accounts moved to https://itslevii.dev
- Lots of fixes

## What's Changed
* fix: Bypass W^X restrictions by @azyarashi in https://github.com/Leviidev/Husk/pull/74
* Fix base APK selection using split manifests by @TakatoSey in https://github.com/Leviidev/Husk/pull/106
* Cocos Creator games start: V8 runs without its JIT (--jitless) by @stellar099 in https://github.com/Leviidev/Husk/pull/113
* Godot 4.7: answer the directory/file handlers for the objects the engine holds by @xinerqu in https://github.com/Leviidev/Husk/pull/151
* fix: discover the dynamic RemotePairing port for Built-in StikJIT by @cklsit in https://github.com/Leviidev/Husk/pull/153
* Fix Flutter font discovery under the Java Android root by @muzhi1991 in https://github.com/Leviidev/Husk/pull/179
* Reserve aligned compressed-heap space before JIT prewarming by @muzhi1991 in https://github.com/Leviidev/Husk/pull/180

## New Contributors
* @TakatoSey made their first contribution in https://github.com/Leviidev/Husk/pull/106

## Known Issues
- Hollow Knight and Cuphead have no sound
- Some games (Disco Elysium, Muse Dash) don't take touch input
- 32-bit only apps don't run

## Final notes
Thank you all, especially everyone who sent a PR this time. Enjoy ❤️

## Links:

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Leviidev/Husk/compare/3.0...3.1

This release contains many new updates improving the user experience! Here's what we added

## Minor updates
- New app logo
- Setup Screen (lets you know if jit is attached and if memory entitlement is working
- Search for games
## Major updates
- Improved boot time
- Added support for many games with unimplemented functions
   - This does NOT guarantee your game will load. All this did was add unadded functions to the app, meaning if an app had an unadded function it would crash, now hopefully adding support for more games.
- Stopped using imgui for aetherps4 loading (using swift now)
- Added touch screen overlay to control game


## Info
### Supported games
Sonic Mania - ✅ Running
2048 (Homebrew) - ✅ Running
Journey  - ✅ Running
### Warning
This app is an experimental build of AetherPS4. AetherPS4 is based off shadPS4, all credits go to them for making the emulator, this project would not be possible without them. This app was also made with the support of Claude, an AI assistant for coding. If you guys have any issues please report it in the GitHub. You can also direct message me on Discord (@ripchase), or DM me on Reddit (u/cultural-order-5549).

## AetherPS4 has a Discord Server, please join if you can (https://discord.gg/xApMHWAzkh). Thanks for using this app, I really appreciate it ❤️

Hey everyone! I present to you AetherPS4 v1.0.0!

## Requirements
Here's what you'll need to get the app working
- StikDebug
- Preferred Sideloading tool
- iOS/iPadOS (26+)
## Setup
First, meet all requirements. Then, sideload the app onto your preferred device. Open ```StikDebug``` and hold click onto the application, you will see a context menu and you must press ```Assign Script```. When the menu shows up press ```universal.js```, this is required or it will NOT work. Then, open the app. Import your .pkg file of the game (must be .pkg, extracted will not work as of right now). When you import your .pkg, you will know it worked when the metadata of the game gets loaded. If it doesn't show the metadata of the game, try refreshing. If it still doesn't show up then you have an invalid .pkg file. Press onto the game and click launch game. The game will take ```1 minute and 30 seconds``` to load, and it will hang for about 30 seconds. Do not close the app or you will have to restart the loading process. Once the game loads, you MUST use an ```external controller```. If you do not use a external controller it will NOT work since we have not added touchscreen overlay.
## Tested Games
### Key:
✅ - Running
⚠️ - Untested
🚫 - Crashed / Doesn't load
### Games:
✅ - Sonic Mania
⚠️ - Minecraft: PS4 Edition

## Other
This app will be regularly updated, and I hope you enjoy
⚠️ This app was made with support from AI tools. I used Claude to help me work on this app. If you have any questions open a github issue. I hope you enjoy!

apps.name: Podium
apps.subtitle: A classic iPod Touch on a modern iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: Podium is a classic iPod Touch emulator. It currently targets iOS 6.1.6 on the iPod Touch (4th generation); other software versions and devices can be tried.

versions.localizedDescription:
Welcome to Podium 0.1.0!

Podium is a iPod Touch emulator for iOS and currently **only** emulates iOS 6.1.6 with the iPod Touch (4th gen.). You can try other software versions and devices, but are probably going to fail as they aren't compatible. I hope you enjoy this release, and remember for JIT, you **must** use **universal.js** in StikDebug. TrollStore / Dopamine support soon.

apps.name: Fathom
apps.subtitle: An x86-64 PC emulator for iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: Fathom is an x86-64 PC emulator for iOS. It runs guest code through FEXCore. 2048 and tic-tac-toe ship as sample programs.

versions.localizedDescription:
An x86-64 PC emulator for iOS, running guest code on FEXCore.

2048 and tic tac toe both run. Add them from the Library tab and play with the on-screen arrow keys.

**Downloads**
- `Fathom.ipa` - the app, unsigned, for sideloading. Needs StikDebug attached for JIT.
- `tictactoe` - arrows move, Enter places, against a minimax bot that cannot be beaten.
- `play2048` - arrows slide the board.

Copy the two game binaries into Fathom's Programs folder, or import them from the Library tab.

apps.name: Henge
apps.subtitle: macOS on your iPhone and iPad.
apps.localizedDescription: Henge runs macOS on iPhone and iPad with its own emulator. It downloads Apple's restore image and installs macOS right on the device, no Mac needed. Safari and Discord run, and the clipboard and a shared folder work between macOS and the device. It's emulation, so it runs slower than a real Mac. Henge needs JIT (StikDebug, its built-in StikJIT on iOS 26 or later, TrollStore or a jailbreak), iOS 17 or later, an A14 or M1 chip or newer, and about 43 GB free.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's new?
- macOS Sonoma 14.6.1 and Ventura 13.6 in the Install tab: smaller downloads (14.1 and 12.3 GB) for devices short on storage
- Sonoma's and Ventura's graphics drivers work with Henge, including Sonoma's moving wallpaper and video, without green bands
- A light theme: Settings › Appearance picks System, Light or Dark (the session stays dark while a Mac runs)
- The screen is a Magic Trackpad 2 to the Mac: macOS's own gestures, tap and hold clicks, and optional volume-button clicks (#54)
- macOS downloads go on after Henge is closed or killed, and a trash button deletes a downloaded or partial one
- macOS shuts down and restarts properly, and a Mac can start again without reopening Henge (#50)
- Installs: a 10 GB Mac no longer runs the phone out of memory two thirds of the way through, the restore streams its ramdisk instead of holding two copies (#39), a second tap can't start a duplicate install (#61), and a Mac finished while the phone locked is still listed
- JIT: tapping Turn On JIT while it's already turning on no longer leaves a second helper attached (that made the Mac 1.5-2x slower), JIT is prepared when StikDebug attaches a moment after opening Henge (#46), and the helper finds the pairing port itself when iOS reports none (#52)
- Speed work on how the emulator handles macOS's TLB flushes and code changes, and a 1.5 GB code cache by default where the memory limit allows
- Lighter macOS (session Details): types a Terminal command that turns off window and Dock animations, widgets, the screen saver and a moving wallpaper; plus a 30 Hz refresh option and Game Mode
- macOS starts with its clock at zero, as on a real Mac, instead of thinking it has been running (and idle) for days
- Web lookups go through the device's own DNS (#34)
- Right-click works (a Control-click, #33), and a physical mouse's right and middle buttons can be swapped (#63)
- The firmware disk reports its real size and takes large transfers (#31)
- Henge has its own AltStore/SideStore source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Leviidev/Henge/main/repo.json

## Confirmed Working
macOS Sonoma 14.6.1 - installs and runs on an iPhone 17 Pro
macOS Ventura 13.6 - installs, logs in and browses on an iPhone 17 Pro
macOS Tahoe 26.6.2 - installs and sets up on an iPhone 17 Pro
macOS 27.2 and Sequoia 15.6.1, as in 0.2

## Known issues
- Monterey isn't offered: it installs, but its desktop never appears.
- Sonoma: choosing the dynamic "Sonoma" wallpaper can stop the screen updating; opening any app brings it back.
- Ventura: the Calendar icon in the Dock is missing its date.
- Emulation is still slow, mostly at login and on macOS 27.
- iOS and iPadOS 17: the screen stays black after the Apple logo (#44). A fix is proposed in #94.
- Safari's pages may stay blank on macOS 27 (not re-checked since 0.2).

## Installation
Sideload Henge.ipa with SideStore or AltStore, or install Henge.tipa with TrollStore or TrollStore Lite. You can also add Henge's source (above) in SideStore or AltStore. Enable JIT, open the Install tab and install macOS. Needs iOS 17 or later, an A14 or M1 chip or newer, and about 43 GB free (less for Sonoma and Ventura).

## Thanks
Thanks to everyone who sent fixes for this release: @not-nullptr, @liukaixiang817, @giladfr, @FlorencioJP, @hikaruright, @hazerbvisor, @kesku, @Jelly-RayTian, @akshaypainjane and @Symplicityy.

## Issues
If any bugs / issues occur, report it to the GitHub or in my Discord Server.

Links:
Discord Server: https://itslevii.dev/discord
Email: hello@itslevii.dev

## What's new?
- macOS 27 (Golden Gate) installs and runs, as well as macOS Sequoia
- Choose your Mac's memory, anywhere from 1 to 16 GB
- Put the Mac on an external display over USB-C, on iOS 27 and on iOS 17-26
- A bit faster: guest memory lookups were reworked, and macOS 27's constant TLB flushes no longer wipe every app's entries
- Settings > Performance: refresh rate (60 Hz, or 120 Hz with ProMotion), faster disk writes, quicker wake from idle, superblocks (experimental) and a 1 GB or 1.5 GB code cache (experimental)
- Colours fixed: macOS no longer looks washed out, and the iPad's P3 screen is colour matched
- iPad: Retina and Performance screen modes, smoother Magic Keyboard scrolling, a smaller and sharper pointer with a size setting, and iPadOS's hide-keyboard key works
- The Mac fills squarer iPhones edge to edge
- Hide the session controls; a three-finger tap brings them back
- JIT: turn it on from the Install tab before your first Mac, LocalDevVPN connects first when it's off, and JIT on cellular says what's wrong and retries (#22, #23)
- Free (personal) Apple developer teams can sign the app
- iPadOS 17 no longer crashes when Metal can't load one of macOS's GPU programs (#12, #24)
- Henge says when iPadOS won't lock the pointer to it in a window (#18)

## Confirmed Working
macOS Golden Gate 27.2 - installs and boots on an iPhone 17 Pro
10 GB of memory for the Mac on a 12 GB iPhone
USB-C external display
macOS Sequoia 15.6.1, as in 0.1

The iPad changes were made and tested by contributors on their own iPads.

## Known issues
- Golden Gate is still slow: the wallpaper can take a couple of minutes to appear. Speed is the main work for the next release.
- Web browsing doesn't work on Golden Gate yet (it worked on Sequoia in 0.1).

## Installation
Sideload Henge.ipa with SideStore or AltStore, or install Henge.tipa with TrollStore or TrollStore Lite. Enable JIT, open the Install tab and install macOS. Needs iOS 17 or later, an A14 or M1 chip or newer, and about 43 GB free.

## Thanks
Thanks to everyone who sent fixes for this release: @dnesdan, @braedonsaunders, @gavinnolan, @lemmylin, @lemarlab, @shrimpapplepro, @hungbenjamin402, @sonnx0868 and @AdamLovattDevOps.

## Issues
If any bugs / issues occur, report it to the GitHub or in my Discord Server.

Links:
Discord Server: https://itslevii.dev/discord
Email: hello@itslevii.dev
